controls.behavior: Inverted matching with an initial nonempty query
controls.source_finding: The selector model begins lazy evaluation before the CLI applies invert_match. A positive initial match can remain cached after the flag is changed.

native_reproduction.failure: For query ap, both apple and banana remained visible and apple was selected instead of banana.

controls.contract_workaround: The selected successful case waits for initial query apx, edits it after startup to force a fresh inverted search, then asserts banana. Correctness of inverted initialization before refresh is not claimed.

controls.behavior: Case-sensitive matching with an initial nonempty query
controls.source_finding: The CLI applies case_sensitive after constructing the model's initial finder. With initial query blue, the lazy initial results contained both Blue and blue.

native_reproduction.failure: The screen retained both Blue and blue; the target emitted Blue where exact stdout required blue.

controls.contract_workaround: V7 waits for the unfiltered screen, enters blue after CLI configuration, requires one result, then asserts lowercase output. Correctness of initial-query case-sensitive filtering before refresh is not claimed.

scope: Pinned target behavior only; no upstream source change, issue, or maintainer contact was made.
